name: 3000 MAH Vape Battery
description:
Introduction to 3000mAh Vape Batteries
When diving into the world of vaping, one crucial component that significantly impacts your experience is the battery. Specifically, a 3000mAh vape battery offers a balance between longevity and performance, ensuring your device can last through the day under moderate use. But what does "mAh" mean, and why is it important for your vaping device?

What Does 3000mAh Mean for Vapers?
mAh stands for milliampere-hour and is a measure of a battery's energy storage capacity. A 3000mAh battery can theoretically supply a current of 3000 milliamps (or 3 amps) for one hour before it's depleted. In the context of vaping, this means more vaping sessions between charges, offering convenience and reliability to users.

Choosing the Right 3000mAh Battery for Your Vape
Not all 3000mAh batteries are created equal. Variations in quality, safety features, and compatibility with your device can make a significant difference. It's essential to choose batteries from reputable manufacturers and ensure they are compatible with your vaping device to get the best performance and safety.

Maximizing Battery Life and Performance
To get the most out of your 3000mAh vape battery, follow these tips:

Charge Properly: Use the recommended charger and follow the manufacturer's instructions.

Store Safely: Keep batteries at room temperature, away from direct sunlight or extreme cold.

Regular Checks: Inspect your batteries for signs of wear, tear, or damage regularly.

name: Hellvape ReBirth RDA
description:
The HellVape REBIRTH 24mm RDA is the result of collaboration with Mike Vapes, implementing an unique two-post build deck, honeycomb style airflow, and a locking top cap to maintain the airflow settings. The build deck features two posts with large terminals measuring 3.5mm by 2.5mm to accept either bigger single coil builds or a dual coil configuration. In addition, the build deck has raised airflows to prevent any leaking and equipping the Rebirth with 6mm deep juice wells for plenty of juice-laden cotton to reside. Furthermore, on the top cap sleeve, 16 honeycomb style airflow inlets allow air to rush in via dedicated channels to hit the coil from underneath and from the side. The airflow is adjustable and can be locked to maintain the airflow settings should one need to drip more juice. The Rebirth RDA also features a squonking BF pin that can allow this vape dripper to be used in squonking applications.

HellVape & MikeVapes Rebirth 24mm RDA Features:

24mm Diameter

6mm Deep Juice Well

Superior Stainless Steel Construction

Dual Post Build Deck

Side Secured via Flathead Screws

Large Terminals - 3.5mm by 2.5mm

PEEK Insulator

Single or Dual Coil Configuration

16-Hole Honeycomb Style Adjustable Airflow Top Cap

Locking Top Cap System

810 Widebore Resin Drip Tip

Gold-Plated BF Squonk Pin

Stainless Steel 510 Connection

Available in Black, Matte Black, Gunmetal, Silver, Purple, Blue, Rainbow
